files.README.md:
# efcore-ddl-mariadb

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities mapped with EF Core 9, repositories over `AppDbContext` and services, in C# for .NET 10. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mariadb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch<T> per field: absent, null or a value.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/App/AppDbContext.cs          the mapping of every table, as the database has it
src/App/Database.cs              the options of DATABASE_CONNECTION
src/App/IUnitOfWork.cs           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/App/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/App/Entities/                one entity per table
src/App/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/App/Services/                one service per table
tests/App.Tests/                 repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json               what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_CONNECTION="Server=localhost;Port=3306;Database=app;User ID=app;Password=app" dotnet test   # a real, disposable database: it is deleted and created again
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

using App.Common;

namespace App.Services;

/// <summary>The values of a Order that change: fields left Patch.Absent keep their value; Patch.Of(null) empties one.</summary>
public record OrderChanges(
    Patch<string> User,
    Patch<int?> Group,
    Patch<string> CustomerName,
    Patch<string?> Class,
    Patch<string?> Metadata,
    Patch<DateOnly?> Date,
    Patch<TimeOnly?> Time,
    Patch<string?> Text,
    Patch<string?> List,
    Patch<string?> Str,
    Patch<int?> Int,
    Patch<DateOnly> DueDate,
    Patch<TimeOnly?> ClosesAt,
    Patch<string?> KindCode,
    Patch<DateOnly?> KindDay,
    Patch<Guid?> ThingId,
    Patch<long?> ParentId
);

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
    <RootNamespace>App.Tests</RootNamespace>
    <!-- The tests share one database and run one after another: no cancellation to pass on -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);xUnit1051</NoWarn>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.v3" Version="4.0.3" />
  </ItemGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="../../src/App/App.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
